notes:
Summary: Nimbus builds a ticket-deflection product sold into mid-large SaaS customers. Current search uses Elastic + TF-IDF; recall OK but relevance/rerank fails on paraphrases. Wants RAG for answer generation + top-5 reranking for deflection. Key asks: tight latency (P95 < 150ms for top-5), predictable cost per query (< $0.005 target), and ability to index ~18M historical tickets + incremental real-time ingestion for new tickets.

POC scope (customer):
- 2M-document sample (tickets + KB) ingestion into Redwood Dedicated or Private eval env.
- Retrieval: approximate NN (ANN) for candidate generation (top 100) + cross-encoder reranker to produce top-5. Customer wants fallback to a distilled add-on model to cut cost if reranker pushes latency beyond SLO.
- Metrics: precision@5, MRR, avg token-cost per query, latency P50/P95, deflection rate delta vs baseline.

Technical constraints / preferences:
- Prefer deployment inside VPC or on-prem due to customer data controls; will accept dedicated pool in major cloud region if VPC peering available.
- Strong SSO requirement (SAML) and KMS-based key management for indexes/keys.
- Data residency: US only for customers, but logs need retention controls (30/90/365 day options).

Cost sensitivity:
- Critical: finance has target of <$0.005 per query at 100 qps steady state. Willing to trade a small increase in latency for lower cost via quantized models / reranker cascades.

Open questions called out:
- How to implement near-real-time incremental indexing (customer expects new ticket availability in ~60s).
- Whether Redwood Optimize suggestions (batching, quantization) can be run as part of POC and produce reproducible cost reduction numbers.
- Expected SLA for dedicated pool (latency SLO vs throughput at 100 qps).

Customer quotes / call notes:
- "We need answers that don't hallucinate — reranker must prioritize factual ticket matches." — Dir. of Support Ops
- "If the POC shows we can shave 20-30% of deflection cost, finance will move to procurement." — VP Product

Stubs/links: POC spec in Drive (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1POC-specs-nimbus), security FAQ (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1-security-faq-nimbus), infra ticket INFRA-7321 (private peering), sec ticket SEC-4509 (SOC2 evidence request).

Suggested Redwood asks / next actions:
1) Provide baseline cost models for: ANN-only, ANN + distilled reranker, ANN + cross-encoder reranker (top-100 -> top-5). Include expected P95 latencies.
2) Confirm dedicated pool sizing for 100 qps with P95 < 150ms and provide test plan for synthetic load.
3) Kick off legal NDA and map security questionnaire owners.
4) Schedule week-of 2026-02-24 infra deep-dive; prep network diagram for VPC peering.
